Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Random root, random interval from a configurable set, pause, then reveal by playing the answer named.
> - Weight the set toward the intervals you keep missing. This is the whole point of writing it yourself.
> - Reuse the harness in Parts 5 and 6 for scales, chords, and cadences.
>
> **Ear drill: ten intervals a day, ascending only, from a set of four. Add a fifth interval when you hit 9 of 10 twice running.**
:::
